probes.risk_hypothesis: Raw streaks remain truthful (seven to zero to one); comeback recognition now explicitly acknowledges the return. Best streak and solve history remain intact. Its effect on returning members still needs measurement.

The same four practice days now satisfy a configurable four-day weekly goal while retaining the factual 4/7 participation ratio. This addresses a demonstrated missing goal signal; retention impact is unmeasured.

observed.second_same_day_attempt: Already counted that problem for this challenge day.

probes.risk_hypothesis: A legitimate same-day review attempt receives no additional counted activity and is not stored in history. This is the specified duplicate-count policy, but can frustrate users expecting a practice-attempt diary.

A future-effective timezone setting now preserves all seven current streak days and all seven submission records without leaving/rejoining. New timezone labels cannot run backwards during a westward transition. Travel-related friction is reduced in this scenario; real usage still needs observation.

The denominator now reads 1/1 known eligible days and separately preserves six unknown days within seven calendar-eligible days. Unknown history is not treated as missed participation; presentation must keep the coverage caveat visible.

Paused members receive no reminder, their leave day is excused in the report, and the same excused day is excluded from weekly progress (1/1 known eligible). This resolves the demonstrated cross-view inconsistency.

100 new pending members receive two batches at 20:00 and no default late reminder. Repeated scheduler ticks do not resend successful batches. Transport is mocked, so this measures message count, not real rate-limit latency.

Personal opt-out works immediately and submitted members are excluded. The dashboard exposes Snooze 1h and Reminders; personal time and optional late pings are configurable. Only the six intended pending members are allowed mentions in the single batch.

retention_observability.missing_signal: No command-view/session/visit events, reminder impressions/clicks, exposure experiments, or precise original acquisition timestamp.
retention_observability.legacy_limit: v2 has lifetime totals plus at most 30 daily buckets; previous joins may have been overwritten; missing days are unknown.
retention_observability.cohort_caveats: Use first observed post-v3 activation cohort; exclude unknown coverage and right-censored users; leavers remain in original cohort denominator.
